Aliceth: When facing Aliceth in PVP, expect her to **bond a hypercarry** such as [[Lily May]] or [[Athalia]] and **mark your farthest unit** for focused burst. The fight is a race to **kill or delay the bonded partner** before arrow volleys stack. **Aegis Wings** saves each bonded hero once from a fatal blow with brief invuln, so plan a second hit or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] through that window. Delete the partner with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Athalia]], and speed your own carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]].
Alna: Alna blankets the field in **opening frost** that cuts Haste and range, then cycles **damage and control immunity** with her **Winter Warrior** — often [[Sylphira]] or [[Frieren]]. Attrition favours her unless you **break the partner** during vulnerable windows before immunity returns. Cut their **delayed blizzard healing** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Frieren]], and pressure the Winter Warrior with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]]. Race her slowed line with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]]. Punish her row before frost locks in with [[Eironn]]'s battle-start pull or [[Mehira]]'s fast pull — not slow setup groupers.
Alsa: Alsa's Arena threat is **Combat Stance** dodge and slam loops, **terrain pillars** that reshape paths, and **boulder dumps on recently controlled** foes. Fights drag into her favor once obstacles funnel your line and control chains feed those boulders. Race with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] before pillars lock pathing — she is **immune to control while curling into a ball**, so do not bank on ult-cancel there. When she rolls out of place, keep pressure with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]] rather than a single assassin pin, and blunt control chains with [[Callan]] so her boulder payoff never stacks.
Antandra: Antandra **shields a frontmost ally**, then **rushes to them** with damage reduction when they dip low, while her ultimate **taunts, goes Unaffected**, and stuns the clump for a self-heal swing. Do not bank on crowd control during that Unaffected window. Bypass the peel by deleting the **soft carry behind her** with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Evie]], or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]], and race your own carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Rowan]] before her Phys DEF stacks from repeated ultimates.
Arden: Arden drops a **persistent lightning cloud** that strikes **controlled enemies** harder and can **bind everyone under it**, while enemy control refunds his energy. Attrition snowballs if his team keeps landing CC. Starve the loop with control-stable frontline like [[Callan]], cancel his slow ultimate with [[Lily May]], and delete him with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Nerion]] before the cloud's strike interval tightens.
Atalanta: Atalanta opens with **chained battle-start knockbacks and explosives**, then **dashes** into a penetrating ultimate line that heals on a clean hit. She relocates too often for single-target assassin pins — answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], and blunt the ultimate with [[Lily May]]. Blunt the opener knockbacks with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Callan]] or [[Sylphira]] on the opening beat, and keep a thick frontline so her line shot never finds a clean lane.
Athalia: In Arena and PVP, Athalia **dives behind your highest damage dealer** and delivers **true damage** tied to their output, so fights hinge on whether she deletes that carry before you stabilize. **Spread damage** or shield the backline early so her target choice matters less. Race her with a sped-up carry — [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] — and peel the threatened carry with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Evie]] or [[Bonnie]]. She relocates too often for assassin pins — lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]] keep pressure wherever she dashes.
Aurora: Aurora **sleeps from battle start** and is **invincible** while dreaming — never bank burst on her sleep form. **Sonny and allied summons** do the damage, focusing the **Nightmare-marked** frontliner while Dream Veil amps the summon line. Delete or shred the **summon providers** with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]], and race with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] before plush fields and summon ATK stacks take over.
Baelran: Baelran banks a huge HP cushion and **transforms when healed to full**, entering Celestial Form and eventually **permanent Unaffected** with frontal true damage and max-HP shred. He is **Unaffected** during the bonus-HP window and form transitions — do not bank on CC there. **Cut his Vitality or healing received early** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]] so heal-to-full and form change stall; softly pressure **heal providers** if they pocket him. **Delete him early** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]] before Celestial Form locks in — [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock only blocks healing *others*, not his own regen and ult restore. Once enhanced and Unaffected, lean on lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]] damage rather than control.
Berial: Berial **selectively hunts isolated targets**, draining energy and **reviving from kills** if left unchecked. Keep allies **within one tile** — tight rows and clustered backlines deny his picks and force him to **heal and retreat** instead of pressing. Avoid wide spreads and solo backliners; once nobody is alone, finish with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], or [[Pandora]]'s area package — do not chase his shadow hops with single-target assassins.
Bonnie: Bonnie opens by **Aging your rearmost** unit — her **magic allies** stack the haste cut further — then her ultimate pays off with bonus damage and stun on Aged foes while she **mists to safety** (invincible). Do not dump burst into mist form. She relocates too often for assassin pins — answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], and blunt her ultimate with [[Lily May]]. Stop the chain by pressuring **Bonnie or her magic partners** before Aging maxes and spreads. **Cleanse** the Aged target with [[Hewynn]], or shorten dispellable debuffs with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Evie]]'s full-intel briefing.
Brutus: Brutus **taunts and shreds Phys DEF**, then **spins Unaffected** with life drain while **Indomitable** cheats the first fatal blow into a temporary immunity. Do not dump your opener into that save or spin window. **Cut Vitality or healing received** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] / [[Gwyneth]] (or [[Satrana]] / [[Igor]]) so spin drain and post-save top-up stay weak, then finish with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or amp'd [[Frieren]]. Race past the stall with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] — physical frontline trades feed his cleave drain.
Bryon: Bryon **opens with a battle-start falcon** that fights untargetable beside him, **drains energy** on hits, and can **block a fatal blow** before making him briefly untargetable. Do not waste [[Lily May]]'s cancel on his opener if you need it for their real carry — he is a classic catcher. Kill **Bryon himself** with sustained mid-fight pressure from [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Evie]] or [[Nerion]] once the falcon's save is spent, race energy with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]], and keep lines **spread** so his multi-target leaves never chain.
Callan: Callan opens **unaffected** behind a battle-start shield that soaks ally damage before he joins the fight; once active, nearby shields **store damage for a burst** release, and low HP can trigger a once-per-battle **Unaffected** howl stun. Early burst into his entry wall wastes damage — bypass or strip the soak and delete the **carry behind him** with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Vala]] before stored might dumps, or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] to delay that partner. Do not bank on interrupting the wrath cast.
Carolina: Carolina **freezes a dense clump**, lays an **arctic Frostbite field**, and grows **orbiting snowballs that auto-hit controlled** foes while shaving Magic DEF. She needs long fights and ally control to ramp. Starve the snowball loop with control-stable frontline like [[Callan]], cancel her slow ultimate wind-up with [[Lily May]], and race with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Rowan]] before DoT and cast stacks mature — or delete her early with [[filter:phys-backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]] before the field settles.
Cassadee: Cassadee **blesses one ally** so their hits add **bonus magic damage** and ramp her haste while that unit lives, then lands a **knockback ultimate line** that also shreds Magic DEF. Kill or delay the **blessed carry** before amplification snowballs — [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]]'s Aging inhibit, or [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]]. If she stays up, pressure Cassadee herself with the same rear-delete tools; dodge her predictable line.
Cecia: Cecia and her **permanent companion** stack attack speed and **enhanced heavy strikes**, while she **binds a target to drain stats** into both fighters. Race to delete her before companion uptime and bind steal snowball — both defenses are **high**, so lean on true-damage rear pressure with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Himmel]] or [[Ravion]], or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]]'s Aging inhibit. Park a **tanky frontliner** on the bind so the drain never finds a soft carry.
Chippy: Chippy's Arena threat is **early companion bodies** at battle start plus **leaps onto a single target**, with rare normal-attack spikes if the fight drags. Wipe the hamsters early, then pressure Chippy himself — he **relocates too often** for a clean assassin pin. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], or race the fight with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]], [[Hugin]], or [[Rowan]] so his luck spikes never matter.
Contess: Contess stays **hidden and untargetable at fight start** while she charges energy, then emerges to **shield her top damage dealer** with Exemption and punish heavy hits with ATK cuts and **energy penalties**. You **cannot burst her while hidden** — avoid conduct violations that surface her on her terms, and do not stack ult spam into silence. When she emerges, **priority-delete the Exemption carry** with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], or lean on lasting [[Shemira]] coverage and [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]]'s Aging inhibit — not opener burst while she is still hidden.
Cryonaia: Cryonaia needs a **wind-up** before her **winter domain** traps top damage dealers and enables **execute thresholds**; inside, only she casts ultimate and weakened targets fall. Until the domain is up she is **vulnerable** — cancel her **high-damage ultimate** with [[Lily May]], pairing [[Pandora]] if they bait the interrupt with [[Niru]] or [[Bryon]]. Kill her in that **early setup window** with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Athalia]]; if you are already trapped, favor **non-ult damage** from [[Gwyneth]] rather than feeding her domain.
Cyran: Cyran's Arena threat is a **battle-start spell chain** — **unaffected** with haste for several seconds — then a throw into densest foes and a **fast black-hole ultimate** that **pulls the whole field** and **executes** low-HP units at the center. **Spread does not stop the black hole** — blunt displacement with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]] (Doomfield also covers the parked ally), and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Callan]] or [[Sylphira]] on the opening beat. Keep HP above execute thresholds. Do not dump opener burst into his **unaffected** window; after it ends, pressure him with mid-fight inhibit/DoT from [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Nerion]] or [[Bonnie]], or lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]], and cancel the hole with [[Lily May]] once he is interruptible.
Daimon: Daimon banks **max-HP drains and Stitchy hits into personal shields**, shares shield with a **bonded ally**, and gains damage reduction while shielded — Stitchy itself is **untargetable**. Break the loop by **deleting Daimon early** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Zorya]] before shields stack, or peel the bonded partner with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]]. Once the shield cycle is online, lean on lasting wide ultimates like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Shemira]] rather than hoping Stitchy dies first.
Damian: Damian **never enters the field** — he is **unhittable** while toy chariots heal, haste adjacent allies, blind, and a plane **stuns your farthest unit**. You cannot delete Damian; **collapse the chariot** so healing, blinds, and plane stuns stop. Answer the toys with **area packages** from [[Shemira]], [[Frieren]], or [[Pandora]], and protect the backline so the plane stun wastes itself. Rebuild windows are his soft phase — finish the fight before a second chariot comes online.
Dionel: Dionel **snowballs ATK SPD** from ally buffs into penetrating lines and a **true-damage sip burst**, then his ultimate **soars untargetable** while raining AoE and knock-up. Do **not** dump burst into the aerial window. He relocates and goes airborne too often for assassin pins — use lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], and blunt the soar with [[Lily May]] when he starts casting. **Pressure his buffer partners** with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Himmel]] so Nectar stacks never peak.
Dunlingr: In Arena, Dunlingr **locks the battlefield** before fight start — either **no healing** or **no ultimates for both teams** — then **extends the order** with his own ultimate. Ult-heavy or heal-heavy comps **handicap themselves** for as long as the rule lasts. Answer with **non-ult kits** on the **exempt carry** he shields from the order — [[Gwyneth]] or [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Athalia]]. **Fast damage** before he re-enforces the rule shortens the window both sides suffer.
Eironn: Eironn's Arena threat is the **battle-start pull** that groups your line for magic damage and immobilize chains. If it lands, formation collapses into his **Magic DEF shred**. Answer on the **same opening beat** with **[[Lily May]]** — her interrupt must land immediately; **[[Pandora]]** is too slow for this window. Blunt the displace with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]] (Doomfield for him and the parked ally), and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Callan]] or [[Sylphira]] on the same opening beat. If the pull still connects, punish the clustered follow-up with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]].
Evie: Evie opens **concealed and invincible** on your side while she **gathers intel**, shredding Magic DEF and fueling a late immobilize/silence — ally ultimates on *her* team slow Detection, not yours. You **cannot burst her while concealed**; end the fight before full intel, or wait until she **reveals and returns**. After reveal she still **dashes often** — prefer lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]] and mid-fight [[Gwyneth]] pressure over an opener assassin dump into concealment.
Faramor: Faramor's Arena threat is the **healing-block circle** of sustained true damage he locks onto a target — he **burns energy to keep it up**, and allies fighting inside deal bonus true damage. **Kill him early** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]]'s true-damage slashes or [[Shakir]]'s wolf form — or [[Athalia]]'s dive paired with [[Himmel]] — so the circle and his ATK pledge both collapse; **step out of the zone** if you cannot reach him (it ends after a second with nobody inside). Heal-heavy lines that park inside feed his anti-heal payoff; once he is dead the zone stops.
Fay: Fay is a **modest healer/buffer** — battle-start heal on the ally ahead, steady HoT, and an AoE splash that heals friends while chipping foes. She rarely wins alone; the threat is whatever **carry she keeps upright**. Outpace her modest sustain by racing your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]], or delete that partner with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Vala]] before her rotation stabilizes. Skip heavy anti-heal packages built only for Fay — her numbers stay modest next to real sustain cores.
Florabelle: Florabelle opens with a **battle-start tank summon**, then grows Bulbsprites with **haste, life drain, and entry shields** while her ultimate **smashes adjacent tiles**. Wipe the summons before Overgrowth and permanent shields stack — her damage collapses without bodies. Clear critters with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]], cancel the smash with [[Lily May]], or delete Florabelle with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Vala]] before the second wave.
Frieren: Frieren starts **concealed and low-priority**, then needs about **15 seconds** to amplify — unless [[Himmel]] fights beside her, which **skips the wait** and adds permanent ATK. After amplify she becomes a **high-damage ultimate** carry with vitality burn and split true damage. That pre-amp stretch is an **early delete window** — burst her there with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Athalia]] (not slow intel setups); with their Himmel present the window is much shorter. Once she is live, blunt her ultimate with [[Lily May]] and **race** with a sped-up carry ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]], [[Hugin]], or [[Rowan]]) so the fight never reaches her peak.
Galahad: Galahad needs time for her **energy circle to fill** before clones and doubled casts come online — she also **binds** your top damage dealer with heal-tied HP loss. **Kill her early** before the zone matures with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Himmel]] or [[Vala]], or starve the energy soak so the circle never completes. Avoid pumping excess heals into whoever she binds, and cancel her opening ult with [[Lily May]]. Once the zone is up, attrition favours her — end the fight before shadow duplicates stack.
Gerda: Gerda **leaps at battle start** (Unaffected mid-cast) to interrupt and drop a **healing hot spring**, then her ultimate **sleeps** clustered foes while healing allies. Do not bank on interrupting the leap. **Spread** so the stomp and spring cover fewer tiles, blunt the sleep with [[Lily May]], and pressure her with early high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]], or lock spring sustain with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock alongside that burst. She relocates into the line — lasting [[Shemira]] coverage beats a single assassin pin.
Granny Dahnie: Granny Dahnie **taunts and retaliates** when damage thresholds trip, then her ultimate **immobilizes nearby foes** while draining HP and energy — she is **Unaffected** for that channel. Do not dump CC into the grass window. **Burst her before the ultimate** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]], and avoid slow chip that only feeds Seed Cannon retaliations. Once she is channeling, lean on lasting wide ultimates like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Shemira]] rather than control, and keep melee carries from camping her taunt cycle.
Gunnar: Gunnar anchors a **Doomfield** on the ally one tile behind him — that partner gains range and ATK, both stay **Steadfast**, and his cannons plus **scorched ultimate** deny heals and shields in the burn. Fights drag into sustained fire unless you break the **field ally** before the meteor owns the mid-fight. Priority-delete that parked carry with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Evie]] — not Gunnar through the shields first — and blunt the meteor with [[Lily May]]. Keep your line out of the fire so his heal and shield denial never locks the attrition.
Gwyneth: Gwyneth stacks **splash CC** and **burn** from a protected rear tile, then rains arrows once her casting rhythm is live — she rewards safe spacing, not an opener dump. Melee that reaches her breaks the attack-speed bonus from empty nearby tiles and stalls the burn chain. Delete her before that chain matures with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Himmel]] or [[Ravion]], or stall her with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]], and cancel the rain with [[Lily May]]. Race a sped-up carry ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Rowan]]) so her sustained pressure never outlasts yours.
Hammie: Hammie is a **light early healer** — she tops the weakest ally, self-heals, and only adds a modest fireball for damage. She rarely wins Arena on her own; the real threat is whatever **fragile carry** she keeps upright through the opener. Outpace her sustain by racing your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]], or delete the ally she keeps healing with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Evie]] before her buffs matter. Skip heavy anti-heal packages built only for Hammie — her numbers stay modest next to real sustain cores.
Harak: Harak opens in **feast mode**, dashing to weak targets and snowballing ATK/HP off assists and kills; when feast ends he **uncontrollably devours** the weakest non-summoned unit — ally or enemy — if they sit under his devour threshold. Deny the multi-kill chaos that extends feast and refunds his ultimate, and keep your weakest **above devour range**. He relocates too often for assassin pins — prefer lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], and cut his life-drain sustain with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Satrana]]. He is **unaffected** during Vicious Bite and the devour — do not bank on interrupting those casts.
Hepler: Hepler toggles **taunt form** for multi-ally heals and shields, spends charges into **permanent DEF and damage reduction**, blinds on revert, and **saves the frontmost ally** from a fatal blow by briefly turning them invincible as an animal. Attrition favors him once those stacks pile up. Burst him and the protected ally **before charges mature** with true-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Athalia]], and cancel Form Shift with [[Lily May]] on a fast window. Do not dump the finishing hit into the animal-form invulnerability — wait for that brief safety to end, then finish.
Hewynn: Hewynn stitches the line with **single-target heals**, a **cleanse** that strips dispellable debuffs, and a slow Rain Prayer that keeps her **unaffected** while allies take less damage. She extends fights rather than ending them — do not bank on interrupting Rain Prayer mid-channel. Outpace her modest sustain by racing your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]], or pressure her carries with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Evie]]; [[Lily May]] can still catch the Rain Prayer wind-up before she goes unaffected. Once her cleanses are spent, Aging packages like [[Bonnie]] stick longer into the mid-fight.
Himmel: Himmel's Arena threat is a **battle-start formation** and petals that buff the party, then **dashes onto two high-damage foes** before a sweeping frontal ultimate — often beside [[Frieren]], who skips her amplify wait. He relocates too often for a clean assassin pin. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]] that keep hitting wherever he lands, blunt the slash with [[Lily May]], and peel his dive victims with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or by racing your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Rowan]]. If their Frieren is adjacent, treat her pre-amp window as much shorter and pressure that pairing early.
Hodgkin: Hodgkin phases **physically immune** with regeneration, then fires cannons for AoE while ATK climbs, steals energy, and pops minions for more drain plus Phys DEF shred. Do not dump physical burst into the ethereal window — answer with **magic** lasting coverage like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], and blunt the regen with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Satrana]]. Cancel Cannon Fire with [[Lily May]] once he is interruptible. Kill or scatter minions before they detonate so the energy-drain chain never snowballs.
Hugin: Hugin shields the **weakest ally**, parks a **rear ATK battery** on the sigil tile behind him, and ultimates the **highest cumulative damage dealer** with ATK and Haste — often early thanks to fast first cast. The matchup hinges on whether that **buffed carry** snowballs, not on killing Hugin through shields. **Shove the parked ally off the tile** with [[Lumont]] or [[Eironn]] so the mid-fight buff drops, or delete/inhibit the partner and top dealer with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Evie]] or [[Bonnie]] before Unstoppable locks in. Race your own carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Rowan]].
Igor: Igor seeds **battle-start tombstones**, leaps for AoE explosions while **Steadfast** on markers, and dodges fatal blows with untargetable hops plus HP recovery. Single-target assassins miss as he relocates. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], cancel Funereal Ring with [[Lily May]] on the opening beat, and cut his sustain with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Satrana]] or [[Gwyneth]]. Clear tombstones between leaps so his dodge has nowhere safe to land.
Indris: Indris opens **exposed weakness** with penetrating shots and true damage when she and her **allies' debuffs** stack, then silences with a permanent DEF cut that snowballs her attack speed. Pressure **Indris and the debuff partners** that feed exposure — those stacks come from their side, not yours. Delete or inhibit her before Spellbane Shot lands with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], and cancel that silence ultimate with [[Lily May]]. Once DEF shred sticks, race a sped-up carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Rowan]] before her weakness windows chain.
Isabella: In Arena, Isabella **bonds the frontmost ally as companion**, pouring ultimate buffs and adjacent healing onto that partner while cutting ATK from anyone who hits them hard. The fight is a race to **break the bond** before spell notes stack and Hexward's unaffected window kicks in — do not bank on lasting CC once it fires. Delete the companion with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]], pressure Isabella with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Evie]], and race your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] before her slow ultimate package matures.
Kafra: Kafra **marks a target**, then **charges out of range** for a stun and Phys DEF shred — his first chase hits hardest, and he **jumps healers** treating the mark while Unaffected. He relocates too often for a clean assassin pin, and **mark kills heal allies** nearby. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], soft-inhibit marked prey with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Evie]] or [[Bonnie]], and keep healers from feeding his chase loop.
Kazim: Kazim opens **invincible and untargetable in Soaring** for about 10s — do not dump burst into that window. He marks airborne prey, then lands into stun volleys and team Haste from marks; After Soaring ends, punish with mid-fight [[Gwyneth]] or lasting [[Shemira]] coverage — not opener assassins into the air. Blunt knock-up with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Shakir]] or [[Sylphira]] during his volley windows.
Koko: Koko's Arena threat is a **slow team-wide ultimate** that blankets **damage reduction and life drain**, while her feast heals and buffs the weakest ally between casts. Burst her **before Full Energy** lands — once the DR window is up, attrition favours her line and recorded damage pays back as true damage. Delete early with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Vala]] or [[Ravion]], blunt the ultimate with [[Lily May]], or race a sped-up carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Rowan]].
Kordan: Kordan drops a **hunting circle** that cuts outside healing and damage into the ring while buffing allies inside, then **enhances and leaps** after the first kill to chase prey. Keep your line out of the ring or end him before **Rage Unleashed** enhancements — outside healers cannot top up allies parked in the zone. Blunt his fast first ultimate with [[Lily May]], delete early with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Perseus]], and once he starts leaping use lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]] rather than chasing each reposition.
Korin: Korin **jumps to the weakest ally** with a shared shield, then dashes for **true damage**, and his ultimate **immobilizes and knocks back** packed fronts. Team ultimate volume later enchants his spear with max-HP true damage, so long ult-spam fights favour him. Keep fronts from clustering into the sweep, and pressure him or the shielded ally before that buff stacks — [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]], or lasting wide ultimates like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Shemira]], work better than chasing every jump.
Kruger: Kruger stacks **Phys DEF shred into Vulnerable**, then drains and amplifies physical hits while permanent ATK rises on Vulnerable kills. Isolated placement also gives him a **battle-start shield with control immunity** — do not open with soft CC into that window. Deny his shred payoff with **magic** lasting coverage like [[Shemira]] or amp'd [[Frieren]], cut the drain with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Satrana]], and **spread** so Vital Strike never chains.
Kulu: Kulu **bombs border tiles into debris** at battle start, then **teleports** for knock-ups and dumps frontliners with Boomboom while her ultimate **bombards the enemy half** — she is **invincible** on the teleport cast and **Unaffected** during the ult channel. Do not bank on interrupts or control during those windows, and do not pin her with single-target assassins as she relocates. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], and blunt debris knock-back and teleport knock-ups with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Callan]] or [[Sylphira]] on the opening debris beat.
Laios: Laios summons a **self-regenerating Living Armor** that soaks focus until its energy collapses, then confuses a frontal cone while hoping for ingredient snowballs. In hero PVP, monster ingredients rarely fuel him — the real threat is the **armor construct** and frontal confuse. Big hits drain the armor's energy faster; collapse it with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]], then finish Laios before he re-summons — the refresh also grants the armor brief control immunity. Keep key casters out of the frontal confuse cone rather than banking on soft control through the armor.
Lamentis: Lamentis floods the field with **apostles** that stack **Growth into Six Eyes**, while his fast ultimate **stuns fronts** and deals heavy AoE magic with max-HP shred. Kill apostles and cut their uptime so Growth never maxes — once Six Eyes opens, free apostles and true-damage Starcrushers snowball. Blunt the opening ultimate with [[Lily May]], and clear waves with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]]. Cut merge healing with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Satrana]], and delete him early with [[filter:true-dmg-backline-assassin]] like [[Pippa]] or [[Athalia]] before the loop stabilizes. If enemy buffers pad the apostles, pressure those **providers** too.
Lenya: Lenya **isolates your top damage dealer in a duel**, dodging normals into **AoE counter-kicks** while non-duel foes deal **reduced damage** to her. Once the duel locks she snowballs with **stat boosts and enhanced kicks**, and she relocates too often for a clean assassin pin. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], **spread damage** across your line so her top-attacker select is unclear, and **race** with a sped-up carry ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]]).
Lily May: Lily May opens with a **defensive ultimate** that **interrupts your first enemy ultimate**, then strikes while **invincible** and **scales through growth** into a carry. The matchup hinges on **where her cancel lands** — waste it on a bait cast rather than your real win button. Frontline a **battle-start ultimate** with [[Niru]] or [[Bryon]] so her interrupt fires on the wrong target. Do not dump into her invincible windows — keep pressure with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]] before growth finishes; she relocates too often for a clean assassin pin.
Lorsan: Lorsan **links nearest and farthest** at battle start so damage and control **share across the chain**, then drops a **Haste-cutting storm** while shielding the **weakest ally** — later with **Unaffected**. Chain breaks **heal his team** and can reset, so long storms snowball. **Delete the protected ally** early with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]] (Unaffected blocks control, not damage), and blunt the storm with [[Lily May]]. End the fight before repeated chain resets refill their line.
Lucca: Lucca is a **frontline disruptor** — **interrupts and disarms**, self-cleanses, and stays **Steadfast** while stacking **shields from allies behind**. The **fast Quake Slam** stuns clustered tiles or returns a target to origin, so packed lines feed that control. You **cannot displace** Lucca — cut through the shields with true-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Zorya]], and cancel the slam window with [[Lily May]]. Keep spacing so the adjacent stun and return slam waste themselves.
Lucius: Lucius mixes **personal and tile shields** with **ally heals on every shield gain** and a soft **frontal ATK cut**. He rarely ends fights alone — the danger is the **extra sustain** keeping their carry alive through your burst window. Block their ally healing with [[Dunlingr]] and delete that carry with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], or **race** past his shields with a sped-up carry ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]]).
Lucy: Lucy **stuns your top damage dealer**, then summons **Aquarius** for repeating **AoE knock-up and stun** while **shielding the weakest ally**. Burst that **kills the companion early** removes both the swirls and the barrier loop. Answer the knock-up with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Sylphira]] or [[Shakir]], and blunt Lucy's early ultimate with [[Lily May]]. Once Aquarius is down, finish her with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Vala]] or [[Athalia]], or mid-fight [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]].
Ludovic: Ludovic anchors a **movable healing field** that restores allies inside, **stuns enemies who enter**, and refills when foes lose HP — long attrition fights are his win condition. He is **Unaffected while generating the field**, so do not bank on interrupting that cast. **Lock ally healing** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock (pair [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Evie]]), or **burst past the zone** with the same early deletes before berries and HP-loss on your top attacker snowball. Comps that never stand in the field waste his heal-damage loop.
Lumont: Lumont **charges a line**, **knocking foes toward a tile** and taunting the clump, while **shields and haste grow** from adjacent enemies and sustained hits trigger **ATK-cutting slams**. He is **Unaffected while charging**, so do not bank on interrupting that cast. Crowded fronts feed his entire kit; sparse lines leave the shields and haste flat. Blunt the knock-back with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Sylphira]] or [[Shakir]], and break shields with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]]. Avoid swarming him so Totem Ward never fully ramps.
Lyca: Lyca **buffs all allies' attack speed**, fuels the opener with **bonus energy**, and layers **meteor pressure plus Phys DEF shred** so physical carries spike. The fight snowballs once meteors and shred are online — end her package early. **Delete Lyca** before the first blessing cycle with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Vala]] or [[Athalia]], or **Aging-inhibit** her with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]]. **Race** your own carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] so her tempo buff never decides the pace.
Marcille: Marcille **channels every skill** — companions, AoE blasts, blinds, heals, and a **revive** — so payoff only lands if casts finish. Break chants with control CC and cancel her ultimate with [[Lily May]] (add [[Pandora]] if they front a [[Niru]]/[[Bryon]] catcher) before summons and revive land — she is not unaffected mid-channel. **Delete her early** with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Vala]] or [[Athalia]] before the first channels resolve. Once companions are flooding, lasting [[Shemira]] coverage still pressures the stationary caster.
Marilee: Marilee **leaps across the field** while shooting, stuns on enhanced normals, and **stacks ATK from ally ultimates** until normals deal **true damage**. Isolation (no adjacent foe) fuels her ATK and attack speed — **close the gap** to deny that bonus. She relocates too often for assassin pins — use lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], or mid-fight [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]]. End fights before max ATK stacks convert her shots into true damage.
Mehira: Mehira charms an area, then **Alluring Mirage pulls the field** into whip HP-loss and haste for her allies — voidlings keep hitting until she **sacrifices one to go untargetable** and heal. Do not dump burst into that window; kill voidlings early. Blunt the pull with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Callan]] or [[Sylphira]] before the opening illusion lands. Cancel the charm ultimate with [[Lily May]], cut her life-drain sustain with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]], and punish the clump with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]].
Mikola: Mikola's PVP threat is the **Courage Sphere** that follows her — buffing and healing allies in range once damage thresholds trip — plus a **central Honor Arena** that freezes aura duration while her side holds it. **Shove allies out of the sphere** with targeted displacement with [[Lumont]] or [[Pippa]] — not enemy pulls like [[Cyran]] or [[Eironn]] — and deny arena ownership. **Delete her early** with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Himmel]] or [[Nara]] before it matures, or **lock ally healing** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock paired with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Himmel]] or [[Nara]].
Mirael: Mirael's Arena package is a **fast burn-line ultimate** that hits harder on already burning foes, then **sustained single-target burn** and permanent **area fireball normals** after the first ult. Grouped lines feed splash and burn bonuses every cycle. Delete her early with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Evie]], blunt Winged Flame with [[Lily May]], and **cleanse** burns with [[Hewynn]] before they stack. Spread so her splash and fireball payoff starve.
Nara: Nara yanks **out-of-range heroes into melee** for knock-up follow-ups, then **executes low-HP targets** with a fast ultimate that can shockwave-heal and refund energy on the finisher. She snowballs ATK off assists and kills. Keep fragile carries **inside her attack range** so the pull never arms, or blunt the yank with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Shakir]]. Kill her before the execute loop with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]], and cancel Crimson Vengeance with [[Lily May]] when she winds up on a wounded mark.
Natsu: Natsu adapts between **stun-heavy frontal AoE** and **raw damage modes**, shaving **max HP** on every hit and applying burns when foes lose HP from non-normal sources. The **first ally defeat** spikes his ATK and DEF — and a bonded [[Lucy]] death adds crit — so attrition tilts his way. Deny easy first blood and keep Lucy alive if they bond her. Interrupt his high-damage roar with [[Lily May]], and delete him early with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]] rather than standing in the arc.
Nazrik: Nazrik marks **Prey**, stacks **Rend** that ticks when victims cast ultimate, and lets **his allies add Rend** on hits into the mark before a spear **detonates** the pile. Rend **cannot be dispelled** — do not plan on cleansing it off. Stop the chain by pressuring **Nazrik or his Rend partners** before stacks peak, and protect your top healer from his anti-heal stun. Delete him early with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Vala]] or [[Himmel]], or cancel the detonation with [[Lily May]].
Nerion: Nerion opens by **drowning your rearmost** with ATK and Haste cuts, then spreads drowning through **control** so his attacks **bounce** and his ultimate amps the chain — full-field drowning unlocks **permanent empowerment**. Control-immune or hard-to-lock lines starve the bounce and the empowerment spike; blunt delayed knock-up with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Sylphira]] or [[Shakir]] through his spear windows. Kill him in the **early window** before every non-summon drowns with [[filter:phys-backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], or **Aging-inhibit** him with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] while you race with a sped-up carry ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]]).
Niru: Niru's Arena threat is a **battle-start ultimate** that stores an ally soul so they keep fighting in **spirit form** after a fatal blow, plus drain heals into the weakest ally and brief heal-block on her pressure target. Expect her free opener to **soak a Lily May cancel** meant for someone else — if you need a wind-up interrupt, pair [[Pandora]] with [[Lily May]] rather than banking the first cancel. Delete the **soul-bound carry** before the fatal blow with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], or finish them through the spirit window with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]]; race your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] so spirit never matters.
Odie: Odie plants a **persistent poison**, stacks its tick damage with repeated triple-shots on the same mark, then **instantly defeats** poisoned foes below a HP threshold. Dart Poison **cannot be dispelled** — cleansing will not break the loop. Stop it by deleting the **poison provider** early with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], and keep soft targets above the threshold so Heart Crusher never pays off.
Orion: Orion opens with a **battle-start rapier enchant** that stacks **Sear** on hit, then recruits **Supporters** from temporary ally buffs to grow **Authority** — at peak stacks he turns **Unaffected** and Sear can silence. Do not bank on CC once Authority locks in. Cut the loop by pressuring **Orion or his buffer partners** before Supporters stack; if they bring **heavy healers or fatal-blow saves**, add **Vitality or healing-received cuts** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]] (or [[Satrana]] / [[Igor]]). Delete him early with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Zorya]], cancel Fatal Waltz with [[Lily May]], or outpace the enchant window by speeding your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]].
Pandora: Pandora's Arena threat is a **global CC ultimate** that freezes everyone while she alone keeps acting, after boxing an ally at battle start for energy and ramping **Corruption** debuffs. Attrition favours her once stacks peak and the **indestructible box** outlives her. **Delete her early** before corruption matures with [[filter:magic-backline-assassin]] like [[Evie]] or [[Pippa]], cancel the freeze with [[Lily May]], and pressure the **boxed partner** — they still act through her ultimate — so that free window cannot snowball.
Pang: Pang channels an **Unaffected ultimate** into a stance that **blocks enemy energy recovery**, while his Chi Barrier keeps him **Unaffected** and retaliates when broken or expired. Do not dump CC or interrupts into those Unaffected windows. Break or wait out the barrier, then pressure him with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]]. **Shatter the barrier before Unyielding Force starts**, or keep him out of melee so the energy-block strikes never land.
Parisa: Parisa marks for **AoE ultimate damage** and **speeds herself plus one ally**, so normals and path shots snowball together. Once marks stack, the fight becomes a dual-tempo race. **Delete Parisa or her buff partner** early with [[filter:phys-backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], or Aging-inhibit the pair with [[Bonnie]] while you race your own carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]].
Peggy: Peggy opens with **two royal guards** and a **fast first ultimate** that heals them and routes ally damage through the summons while she heals and amps ranged and summon lines. Once the absorb window lands, hero focus fire wastes itself on guards. Cancel that opening ultimate with [[Lily May]], or **delete Peggy** before guards stabilize with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Himmel]] or [[Vala]]. Spread pressure across **guards and Peggy** so the protection package never locks.
Perseus: Perseus **marches through packed lines** with AoE, knockback, and stun while **unaffected**, seeding **fertile ground** that buffs nearby allies and converting temporary buffs into his own ATK. Do not bank on CC during the march. **Shove buffed allies off his fertile tiles** with targeted displacement — [[Lumont]] or [[Pippa]] — not enemy pulls like [[Cyran]] or [[Eironn]], which group foes instead of evicting receivers. He is **unaffected while marching**, so peeling him mid-push fails; answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]]. Starve the ATK loop by inhibiting temporary-buff partners with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]].
Phraesto: Phraesto sacrifices HP to field an **Illusion that copies his kit**, while both grant **rear-ally contracts** and battle-start row shields; his active ultimate **heals per nearby hit**. Prefer killing **Phraesto himself** — defeating the Illusion first triggers his stun punish. Delete him with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]], and blunt the heal loop with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]]. Soften rear-buffed carries with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Nerion]] so contracts cannot snowball.
Pippa: Pippa **immobilizes and teleports** foes on ultimate, then dumps missiles and magical growth on the **densest clump** while draining energy. Sparse lines blunt growth and portal follow-ups. Blunt the rear teleport with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Sylphira]] or [[Ravion]] on the threatened carry, and cancel the teleport ultimate with [[Lily May]]. Delete her early with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]] before growth and haste stacks snowball.
Ravion: Ravion **assigns objectives** that fuel allies with energy and ATK, then **teleports** for early jump damage before resetting while his ultimate scales on target HP-loss. He relocates too often for a clean assassin pin. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], and blunt his ultimate with [[Lily May]]. Pressure **objective runners** with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]] so the team-buff unlock never lands cleanly.
Reinier: Reinier's Arena opener **swaps symmetrical ally-enemy positions**, wounding and ATK-swinging the mirrors, then his ultimate can **remove himself and a key foe** into a private duel. Blunt the displace with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]] (Doomfield for him and the parked ally), and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Callan]] or [[Sylphira]] — Unaffected forces Mutual Reflection into damage instead of the dimension trip. Do not bank on hitting him during the dimension trip. After swaps settle, mid-fight [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Nerion]] pressure the wounded line, and cancel the removal ultimate with [[Lily May]].
Rhys: Rhys **kites while attacking**, loading **Blast Ammo** on a slow ultimate into splash-enhanced normals, and gains **control immunity when hit by CC**. He relocates too often for assassin pins. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]] that keep hitting wherever he moves, and blunt the ammo ultimate with [[Lily May]]. Collapse kite space early with [[filter:enemy-grouping]] like [[Eironn]] or [[Mehira]] so splash normals never find open ground.
Rowan: Rowan is a **steady energy battery** — his ultimate fuels nearby allies while consumable heals and a **super heal** raise DEF, and his companion **drains enemy energy**. Grouped hypercarries snowball once the battery loops. **Delete him early** with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Nara]] or [[Himmel]] before the first energy dump, or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]]. Race opposing carries with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] so his battery never decides the tempo.
Saida: Saida **teleports in**, plants **Drain Seeds** that chip and **drain Energy**, then snowballs **shields, damage reduction, and a seed-fueled revive** while markers stay live. Assassin pins **miss her hops** — answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]] that keep hitting wherever she lands. **Cut her Vitality or healing received** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] / [[Gwyneth]] (or [[Satrana]] / [[Igor]]) so self-heal and post-revive top-up stay weak — [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock alone does not shut off her own sustain. Pressure **Saida before seeds multiply** with mid-fight inhibit from [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]], and race the loop with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]].
Salazer: Salazer is a **low-HP finisher** — arcs hit harder on wounded foes, then **imprison** cages a soft target, **heals him**, and **resets his whip** for chained executes. Keep your line **above imprison thresholds** with early sustain so his reset loop never starts. Delete him before the first cage with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Athalia]], or blunt follow-up with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]] once he is committed to a mark.
Satrana: Satrana's ultimate makes her **invincible** while she burns the field, and **Sparks** let her allies **ignite** your line for Vitality cuts, DoT, and team-wide magic mitigation once burns stick. Do **not** dump burst into Fiery Dance. After invulnerability ends, pressure **Satrana and her Sparks partners** — the ignite providers — with mid-fight [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Nerion]], or lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], before every foe is ignited and her arc cooldown drops. **Cut her Life Drain** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]] so she cannot out-sustain through the burn setup.
Scarlita: Scarlita **blinks airborne and stays invincible** for up to about 15 seconds, shielding allies and stacking execution, then descends with AoE stun — her ultimate also **knocks lines to the edge**. You **cannot burst her while airborne**. Answer the edge wave with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Sylphira]] or [[Shakir]], and punish on **descend** with mid-fight [[Gwyneth]] or lasting [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]]. Sparse formations blunt the rock wave; collapsing her living allies can force an earlier landing.
Seth: Seth **flashes and pounces** onto weak marks, then **resets on kills** to chain across your line. His ultimate is **invincible during the cast**, and single-target assassins **struggle to pin** him as he relocates. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], keep your weakest **above easy pounce range**, and deny kill chains by bursting him between pounces when he is exposed.
Shadewing: Shadewing stacks **lost-HP DoT** and converts **continuous damage on enemies** into a **curse lash**, front-loading ATK by draining an ally at battle start. Short fights blunt the curse fill. Pressure **Shadewing and their DoT partners** — the providers that feed the curse — with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or early [[Himmel]] / [[Eironn]], and race him with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] before the lash threshold.
Shakir: Shakir **transforms into Wolf Form** for frontal cleaves with **Life Drain** and **Ranged DEF**, and his **Lupine Aura** damage reduction scales with allies clustered on him. **Shove aura receivers out of the zone** with targeted displacement with [[Lumont]] or [[Pippa]] — enemy pulls like [[Cyran]] or [[Eironn]] group **your** line, they do not evict his packed allies. He is **Unaffected in Wolf Form**, so do not bank on peeling him off the cluster. **Cut Vitality or healing received** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] / [[Gwyneth]] (or [[Satrana]] / [[Igor]]) so Life Drain cannot out-bruise you, and pressure him with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]].
Shemira: Shemira **burns her own HP** to fire orbs, then her **slow ultimate** floods the board with **random ghost bombardment** that widens as heroes fall. Attrition and summon count favour her unless you **end the fight early**. Delete her before the procession locks in with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Nara]] or [[Himmel]], blunt the ultimate with [[Lily May]], and **deny the HP recovery** that fuels her sacrifices with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]]. Race her with a sped-up carry ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]]).
Silven: Silven sits **stationary** behind a **Tempered Field**, launching blade volleys and detonating **Blademarks** on knock-downs while **ally buffs** refund Energy, Penetration, and ATK SPD. **Delete him early** before the field and buff loop peak with [[filter:phys-backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]], or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]], and blunt knock-downs with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Sylphira]] or [[Shakir]] so Blademarks never detonate. Pressure **his buffers** so refunds never fuel the blades, or race a sped-up carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] if the fight runs long.
Silvina: Silvina **opens by flashing** to a symmetrical foe, then her ultimate strikes the **highest-Energy** enemy to **drain their cast**. Protect Energy-heavy carries and avoid an easy symmetrical dive mark on the opening beat. **Delete her early** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]] before the drain lands, **cancel the ultimate** with [[Lily May]], and peel the threatened caster with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]].
Sinbad: Sinbad **marks your top attacker and top damage-taker**, then focuses those roles with **adapted debuffs** and a multi-hit ultimate. Spread damage so no single carry owns both marks, and keep priority units from sitting isolated. His **high movement** wastes assassin pins — answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] on marked carries, and true-damage melee pressure like [[Himmel]] or [[Zandrok]] on Sinbad himself. **Race** with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] so marks never fully land.
Smokey & Meerky: Smokey & Meerky anchor Arena with a **channeling healing aroma** that feeds ATK and energy while allies stay packed inside — they **drop it under Control Effects** and face a **4s recreate lockout** after interrupt. **Break the channel** with [[Lily May]] or stun/sleep CC, **shove receivers out** with [[Lumont]] or [[Pippa]], and **delete them early** with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Nara]] before the aroma peaks. **Lock ally healing** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock (C — pair [[Frieren]] / [[Gwyneth]]), and **race** with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]].
Solise: Solise attaches **healing companions** at battle start and snowballs **overheal into blooms**, shields, and companion damage — her ultimate **heals the whole team** while companions hit every foe. She is **unaffected while casting**, so do not bank on interrupting Life's Embrace mid-channel. **Lock ally healing** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock (C — pair [[Ravion]] / [[Himmel]]), **delete her early** before blooms with those same picks, and **spread** clustered lines so overheal never charges companions. Add Vitality cuts from [[Frieren]] / [[Gwyneth]] once Curelock is active.
Sonja: Sonja's Arena threat is the **battle-start pact** that continuously buffs her **left and right allies** — preferring the front — while all three live; her multi-hit charge is secondary. The fight hinges on whether those **flanking partners** survive long enough for bond bonuses to snowball. **Priority-delete the pact allies** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Athalia]], or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] if they park a rear carry on her flank. **Race** your own carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]] before her haste growth locks the front — Tempest Thrusts is **control-immune** for the full cast, so do not rely on ult-cancel there.
Soren: Soren's Arena threat is **knockback-and-stun collision chains** that reset whenever his block absorbs a big hit, so clustered lines feed his follow-ups. He **repositions to maximize collisions** and recovers with a low-HP haste surge. Blunt collision knock-back with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]] (Doomfield for him and the parked ally), and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Shakir]] or [[Sylphira]] through the block-reset loop. **Burst him before the block cycle** with high-damage melee like [[Sylphira]] or [[Eironn]], or finish with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]] once he is soft.
Sylphira: Sylphira opens with a **fast silencing domain** and multi-hit follow-ups, then **activates her score** for huge ATK/Haste plus self-cleanse, energy refunds, and **Life Drain**. Until that score lights she is still killable; after it, attrition and silence favour her. She is **Unaffected inside the domain** and **control-immune** while casting Piercing Silence — do not dump CC there. **Delete her early** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Athalia]] before the score peaks, and blunt the domain ultimate with [[Lily May]]. **Cut Vitality or healing received** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] / [[Gwyneth]] so Life Drain and score sustain stay thin. **Race** a sped-up carry ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]]).
Talene: Talene **burns her own HP** into flames that scale ATK and heal allies, then **resurrects as an unhittable flame** when defeated — do not dump burst into that form. She also buffs the **frontmost ally** with adjacent pressure. **Delete her early** with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Himmel]] before flame scaling snowballs. **Deny sustain**: [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] / [[Gwyneth]] cut her recovery and post-revive top-up; [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock (C — pair that delete path) blocks the ally heals she pumps. After the flame fades, finish with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]] and pressure the **frontmost enhanced ally**.
Tasi: Tasi's Arena threat is **team-wide sleep** from a **late ultimate**, while she **leaps across the field** stunning and ramping after each dream. At half HP she **transforms into an invincible butterfly** — do not dump burst into that form. Single-target backline assassins **struggle to pin her** as she relocates. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], blunt the sleep with [[Lily May]] when her ultimate comes online, and **cut Vitality or healing received** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] / [[Gwyneth]] so butterfly recovery stays thin.
Temesia: Temesia **charges the farthest enemy** with path damage and **mounted knockdown leaps**, then gains **permanent Unaffected** and true damage after enough ult charges. She relocates too often for assassin pins, and late-fight Unaffected wastes CC. Answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], blunt the leap with [[Lily May]], and use [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]] against the knockdown — [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Shakir]] or [[Sylphira]] only if their window overlaps the leap. End the fight before her charge count locks Unaffected.
Thador: Thador's Arena threat is the **rear ally bond** that grants crit, shared shields, and — when that partner ultimates — **team-wide Phys and Magic DEF shred**. Kill or delay the **bonded carry** before that payoff, not Thador alone. **Priority-delete the bond partner** with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]], and blunt Thador's own ultimate with [[Lily May]] if it is their win button. **Race** your carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Hugin]] or [[Rowan]] so their bond never dictates the pace.
Thoran: Thoran **plunders the highest-HP enemy**, banks a revive, and while charging his ultimate is **Unaffected** — do not bank on interrupting Soul Retaliation mid-channel. A **pact ally behind him** can also spend HP to bring him back once. **Cut Vitality or healing received** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]] through the first life and revive window so plunder-and-revive top-ups stay thin. **Delete the pact partner** with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]], burst Thoran with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]] before revive pays off, and keep your tankiest unit from feeding Soul Plunder.
Tilaya: Tilaya opens by converting most of her HP into **Vine Ward** — she is **Unaffected while the shield holds**, and her damage scales off current shield value. Do not bank on CC or interrupts during Ward; attrition favours her if the barrier keeps rebuilding. **Strip the Ward** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Nara]], or lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]], then punish the brief cooldown gap before it restores. **Race** with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]], [[Hugin]], or [[Rowan]] so the fight ends before Verdant Growth locks her sustain.
Twins: The Twins **link a line** for energy and healing, then **Starlight Waltz** haste-buffs allies and makes **linked partners Unaffected** for the channel. Attrition and immune windows favor them once bonds are set. **Race** their carry with [[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]], [[Hugin]], or [[Rowan]], and pressure the **linked hypercarry** with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Himmel]] before the waltz locks them. Cancel the dance with [[Lily May]] when it comes online — do not bank on CC during the Unaffected window.
Ulmus: Ulmus tanks behind a **breakable shield**, then at low HP **retreats and takes root** — **Unaffected** while rooted, shifting to energy regen and ally shields. You can still damage him through the root; do not waste CC there. Blunt knock-up and shield-break shoves with [[filter:steadfast]] like [[Igor]] or [[Gunnar]], and [[filter:unaffected]] like [[Sylphira]] or [[Shakir]]. **Burst him before the root** with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Shakir]], or finish the rooted phase with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Gwyneth]] once he is planted and soft.
Vala: In Arena, Vala **marks your farthest unit** at battle start, **drains their Energy** on each hit, and flips between **ranged stun** and **melee true-damage** modes as she relocates. After a marked kill she **blends into darkness and becomes untargetable** — do not dump burst into that window. She moves too often for a clean assassin pin; answer with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], blunt her stun-mode ultimate with [[Lily May]], and peel or race the marked carry with [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Bonnie]] or [[Evie]], or a sped-up line ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]]).
Valen: Valen's Arena threat is **Thunder Swordwork** — he is **invincible while striking**, then rides **Invigoration** into chain lightning and an **AoE stun** that snowballs ATK stacks. You **cannot burst him during the invincible cast**; after it ends the fight hinges on Invigoration uptime and how tightly you are clumped for forked lightning. Cancel the ultimate with [[Lily May]], **spread** so chains waste themselves, and punish the soft window with Magic melee like [[Eironn]] or lasting [[Shemira]] once he is hittable.
Valka: Valka opens with a **battle-start shield and ally ATK SPD**, stacks **Panic** into a **fast true-damage ultimate** that heals her while she is **Unaffected**, and **parries ultimate damage** in range with a free counter. Do not bank on interrupting Blooming Terror mid-cast, and avoid feeding Soulshock Riposte with ultimates into her face. Blunt the ultimate with [[Lily May]], delete her **before Panic completes** with true-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Zorya]], cut the ult self-heal with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]], or lean on lasting [[Shemira]] pressure from outside her riposte range.
Velara: Velara **plants magic circles** that awaken into healing, haste cuts, and eventually **battlefield-wide** coverage — once all are live, later casts grant allies **Unaffected** and damage. She also **immobilizes your top damage dealer**. Circles **charge faster from her allies' debuffs** on nearby foes — pressure **Velara and those debuffer partners**, not your own composition. End the fight before full awakening with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Dunlingr]]'s Curelock paired with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Evie]], or race a sped-up carry ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]] or [[Hugin]]); mid-fight [[Bonnie]] Aging stalls her setup.
Viperian: Viperian **burns HP at battle start** while **Unaffected**, sending possessing DoT summons across your line, then sustains through drains and summon returns — a late **Crimson Waltz** burst also leaves her **Unaffected** while casting. Do not dump opener burst into either window. **Cut Vitality or healing received** with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]] so drains and recall top-ups stall, delete her once possession deploy ends with [[filter:backline-assassin]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Nerion]], and lean on lasting wide ultimates like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Shemira]] before Crimson Waltz lands.
Walker: Walker's Arena threat is **battle-start grenades** that stun and shred Phys DEF, then a **fast Six-Shot ultimate** that keeps stunning while he later **bounties your top damage dealer**. The opening stun chain decides whether your carry ever acts. Blunt Six-Shot with [[Lily May]], delete him early with high-damage melee like [[Shakir]] or [[Himmel]] before the bounty locks, and [[filter:backline-inhibit]] like [[Evie]] or [[Nerion]] on the marked carry while you race your own ([[filter:energy-provider]] like [[Thador]], [[Hugin]], or [[Rowan]]).
Zandrok: Zandrok's Arena threat is the **battle-start illusion charge** that **inspires allies** with huge max HP, Life Drain, and Haste, then **HP-scaling** slams and stomps as excess healing **converts into more max HP**. Long fights favour his snowball — pressure **Zandrok and his heal providers** before the pool balloons. Cut Vitality or healing received with [[filter:heal-inhibitor]] like [[Frieren]] or [[Gwyneth]], delete him early with high-damage melee like [[Himmel]] or [[Perseus]], and finish with lasting wide ultimates like [[Gwyneth]] or [[Shemira]] once the inspire window is spent.
Zanie: Zanie **deploys unaffected laser turrets and a gun turret** at battle start, then buffs their ATK and ATK speed on ultimate while repairs and upgrades keep the field alive. The matchup is a race to **collapse the turret line** before linked lasers and burns melt your backline. Clear the summons with lasting wide ultimates like [[Shemira]] or [[Frieren]], then delete Zanie with [[filter:assassin-delete]] like [[Ravion]] or [[Nara]] before Field Repairs and Precision Overload restabilize; blunt her power ult with [[Lily May]] if the buff window is their win condition.
Zorya: Zorya begins **dormant and invincible**, banking energy until she awakens and **jumps into the densest enemy clump** for AoE, life drain, and a haste-slow aura. You **cannot damage her while dormant**. After she wakes she still has **fading 70% stone skin** for ~10s — that is a **late delete window**, not an opener dump. Prefer **sustained or long ultimates** from [[Gwyneth]], [[Shemira]], or amp'd [[Frieren]] once the reduction fades; **spread** so her jump and nearby-enemy bonus waste themselves. One fatal blow forces dormancy again — use that reset rather than overcommitting into her first awake window.
